from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyAccountsPayable(BaseModel):
    """One company's accounts payable data extracted from a financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Company name as reported in the document")
    accounts_payable_amount: float | None = Field(description="The accounts payable amount extracted from the balance sheet")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="How the amount is expressed, e.g. 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions' or '元'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="Short verbatim excerpt anchoring the extracted amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_accounts_payables: list[CompanyAccountsPayable]
